prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square fantasy voxel tower-defense inventory icon. Subject: a compact oak-and-iron ballista cannon, wooden stock, twin steel bow arms, amber bolt. Original Warcraft-era fantasy RTS spirit combined with Minecraft-like chunky voxel geometry. One isolated complete tower only, three-quarter isometric view, centered and filling 80% of the square. Painterly high quality game inventory art, crisp chunky silhouette, warm rim light, subtle material wear. Dark desaturated forest-teal background with a soft vignette. No text, no letters, no numbers, no border, no watermark, no extra objects. Consistent icon art direction across the set.
